caption:
More ads won't fix a shop that can't handle what it already has.

Every service business hits one of three ceilings before revenue stalls:

1. Ad Capacity - the spend level where cost per lead outruns your close rate.

2. Response Capacity - most shops take over an hour to answer a new lead, while a 5-minute response can double the odds of closing it.

3. Delivery Capacity - the job volume your crew and calendar can run before the work slips.

Whichever ceiling sits lowest sets your revenue. It rarely matches the one you're watching closest.

This week, line up three numbers: leads this month, average response time, jobs booked. Wherever that count drops hardest is your real limit.
